input.detail:
Addressed 3 relationship findings in commit 1fe9bd1:

Finding 1 — loadSave duplication: Created app/hooks/useSave.ts as the single save initialization coordinator with SSR guard. Refactored useGameSession (removed separate settings state + loadSave in useMemo), useWorldSession (delegates to useSave), and useRainbowEasterEgg (uses updateSave callback instead of direct loadSave+saveSave).

Finding 2 — SVG constants in hook: Moved SVG_WIDTH, SVG_HEIGHT, ARC_CENTER_Y_RATIO from useRainbowEasterEgg to app/lib/rainbow-constants.ts. Both the hook and RainbowArc component now import from the lib module, eliminating the cross-layer constant dependency.

Finding 3 — routes→engine dual access: Created app/hooks/useLevelById.ts for play.tsx. Expanded useWorldSession to expose worlds/getLevels. Both routes now access engine exclusively through hooks. Added ESLint rule blocking routes→engine imports + zone-boundary test verifying enforcement. All 29 tests pass.
